For the real charge, the position vector to P=(√2,√2,0) is R1=(√2,√2,-2), and its magnitude |R1|=sqrt(2+2+4)=2√2. The common coefficient q/(4πepsilon0 |R|^3)=32πepsilon0√2/(4πepsilon0(2√2)^3)=1/2. Therefore the real charge contribution is E_real=(√2/2)i+(√2/2)j-k; the image charge contribution is E_image=-(√2/2)i-(√2/2)j-k. After adding, the x and y components cancel, and the z component is -2, so E=-2 k-hat N/C.
